1️⃣ Investing money you'll need soon → build a safety fund first
2️⃣ Putting everything in one stock → spread the risk

₹12,000: invest it all at once, or ₹4,000 a month for 3 months? 🤔

Lump sum at ₹100 → 120 units
SIP when the price goes ₹100 → ₹80 → ₹100 → 40 + 50 + 40 = 130 units
SIP when the price goes ₹100 → ₹120 → ₹150 → 40 + 33.3 + 26.7 = 100 units

That's rupee cost averaging: dips help a SIP, steady rises help a lump sum. Neither is always better.

Which would you pick? Comment SIP or lump sum 👇

India apna 85% se zyada crude oil import karta hai 🛢️ Isliye tel ka daam aapke stocks ko hilata hai.

• Crude mehnga → import bill ↑ → zyada dollar chahiye
• Rupee kamzor → imports mehnge, inflation ka risk
• Airlines, paints, oil companies: laagat crude se judi
• Crude sasta → inhi sectors ki laagat kam ho sakti hai

Par stocks sirf tel se nahi chalte: earnings, interest rates aur global mood bhi matter karte hain.

Bada loss wapas laana itna mushkil kyun hai? 📉

−10% → +11.1% chahiye
−25% → +33.3%
−50% → +100%
−75% → +300%
−90% → +900%

Formula: loss ÷ (100 − loss). Isliye pehle downside protect karo.

Aapne stock ₹100 par khareeda. Galat nikla, to exit kahan karoge? 🤔

Yahi hai stop-loss: ek exit price jo aap kharidne se PEHLE tay karte ho.

• Stop ₹95 → risk ₹5 per share = 5%
• Bina stop: ₹100 → ₹70 = −30%
• ₹70 se ₹100 wapas aane ke liye ~43% gain chahiye

Pehle exit, phir entry.

Aap stop-loss use karte ho? Comment karo 👇 Aur follow karo.

Agar main zero se trading shuru karta, to pehle ye 3 rules set karta 👇

1️⃣ Paper trade pehle: asli paisa lagaye bina practice
2️⃣ Har trade mein chhota, fixed risk: ₹50,000 ka 1% = ₹500. 5 galat trades ke baad bhi ₹47,500 bache
3️⃣ Trade journal: kyun liya, kahan exit, kya seekha

Ye candle padh sakte ho? 3 second ⏱️

• Body = open se close
• Green: price open se UPAR band hua (₹100 → ₹110)
• Red: open se NEECHE band hua
• Upar ki wick = high, neeche ki wick = low
• Bahut saari candles saath = trend

IPO mein apply kar diya. Ab aage kya hota hai? 👇

1️⃣ Price band: company range deti hai (example: ₹95–₹100)
2️⃣ Lot size: shares lot mein milte hain (example: 150 × ₹100 = ₹15,000)
3️⃣ UPI bid: paisa sirf block hota hai, abhi debit nahi
4️⃣ Allotment: demand zyada ho to retail mein lottery jaisa system. Mile to debit, na mile to unblock
5️⃣ Listing: SEBI rule se issue band hone ke 3 working days baad (T+3)

Listing price upar bhi khul sakta hai, neeche bhi. Koi guarantee nahi.

Kisi bhi IPO mein apply se pehle ye 7 cheezein check karo 👇

1️⃣ Business: company paisa kaise kamati hai?
2️⃣ 3 saal ke numbers: revenue aur profit ka trend
3️⃣ Use of funds: growth ya purana loan?
4️⃣ Fresh issue vs OFS: paisa company ko ya purane shareholders ko?
5️⃣ Valuation: same sector ki companies se P/E compare
6️⃣ Risk factors: RHP ka risk section padho
7️⃣ Promoter holding: IPO ke baad kitna hissa bachega?

Inmein se kaunsa aap skip karte the? Comment karo.

Investing shuru karne ke liye lakhs chahiye? Myth hai 👇

✅ Share market: sirf 1 share bhi khareed sakte ho
✅ Mutual funds: kai funds ₹500 ya usse kam ki monthly SIP allow karte hain (har fund ka minimum check karo)
✅ ₹500 × 12 mahine = ₹6,000 jama. Ye return nahi, aapka apna paisa hai
✅ Income badhe to SIP badhao

Pehle emergency fund. Jo paisa jaldi chahiye, wo market mein mat daalo.

Ye Reel us dost ko bhejo jo lakhs ka wait kar raha hai.

RBI ek number ko itna serious kyun leta hai? 👇

📊 CPI = ek basket (khana, kiraya, fuel, kapde) ka price, har mahine
💸 Example: 6% inflation par ₹100 ki cheez saal baad ₹106 ki
🎯 RBI ka target: 4% inflation, 2% se 6% ki range
🏦 Inflation zyada rahe to RBI repo rate badha sakta hai, loan EMI mehengi
📈 Isliye CPI data aate hi market mein halchal

Paisa double hone mein kitne saal? 10 second ka trick 🧮

Rule of 72: 72 ÷ saalana return % = lagbhag saal
• 8% → 72 ÷ 8 = ~9 saal
• 12% → 72 ÷ 12 = ~6 saal
• 24% wala loan (na chukao to) → 72 ÷ 24 = ~3 saal mein double 😬

Ye sirf andaza hai, guarantee nahi. Asli returns upar neeche hote hain.
